headline: AI Capex Worries Spark US Treasury Rally and Fuel Safe-Haven Japanese Yen
summary: Anxiety over heavy capital requirements for artificial intelligence triggered the biggest US Treasury rally in over three years. The tech slump also spurred safe-haven flows into the Japanese yen while Asian equities stumbled.
why: Massive capital expenditure commitments by technology giants directly influence corporate cash flows and interest rate expectations in global bond markets.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Investors moved into safe-haven currencies amid declining risk sentiment across Asian and tech equities.

impacts.name: US Treasuries
impacts.why: Tech sector volatility and scaling back of rate hike bets generated broad flight-to-safety demand for government bonds.

why_moved: Bond prices jumped and the yen rose as investors fled volatile technology equities over concerns about high AI development costs.
